description: Golden cases for IngressSpec execution. Every ingress runtime must produce these verdicts and keys exactly.

cases.name: header_equals: exact match
header_equals: header name is case insensitive
cases.note: Header lookup must be case insensitive in every runtime.

cases.name: header_equals: wrong secret
header_equals: header absent
header_equals: empty header value
header_equals: secret with trailing character
header_equals: whitespace padded secret
cases.note: No trimming: the comparison is over exact bytes.

cases.name: hmac_sha256: valid signature with prefix
hmac_sha256: signature without the required prefix
cases.note: The prefix is part of the expected value, not stripped from the candidate.

cases.name: hmac_sha256: empty prefix accepts a bare digest
hmac_sha256: digest of a different body
hmac_sha256: digest under a different secret
hmac_sha256: signature over unmodified bytes
cases.note: Body must be signed as received. Decoding and re-encoding reorders keys and escapes non-ASCII, which changes the digest.

cases.name: hmac_sha256: signature over re-encoded bytes must fail
cases.note: Guards the round-trip mistake explicitly: this digest is valid for the re-encoded body and must still be rejected.

cases.name: hmac_sha256: header absent
hmac_sha1: valid signature
hmac_sha1: sha256 digest is not accepted
query_param: matching token
query_param: mismatched token
query_param: token absent
none: accepts any request
cases.note: The unguessable public hash is the only credential for this scheme.

cases.name: template: channel placeholder
template: top level scalar
template: nested dot path
template: header lookup
template: missing path collapses to empty
template: path through a scalar leaf
template: non scalar value collapses to empty
template: boolean renders as 1
template: false renders as 0
template: float renders without formatting
template: float with zero fraction loses it
cases.note: Numbers render as values, not as their JSON spelling. A runtime that echoes the literal would emit "1.0" here.

cases.name: template: large integer keeps full precision
cases.note: Must not go through a float: that would round to 9223372036854775808.

cases.name: template: unknown namespace collapses to empty
template: no placeholders
template: malformed body yields empty placeholders
cases.note: Ingress must answer the provider even for garbage bodies.

cases.name: template: json array body yields empty placeholders
cases.note: An array body has no field of that name.

cases.name: template: array element by numeric segment
cases.note: PHP resolves a numeric string against integer array keys, so array elements are addressable. A runtime that only walks objects would return an empty key here and dedupe unrelated messages together.

cases.name: template: nested array element
template: array index out of range
hmac_sha256: viber signature over the raw body
cases.note: Viber signs the raw body with the bot token as the key and sends a bare lowercase hex digest. The 19-digit message_token must survive without rounding.

cases.name: hmac_sha256: viber webhook callback is verified
cases.note: The set_webhook callback is a callback like any other and carries the same signature.

cases.name: hmac_sha256: viber signature under a different token
hmac_sha256: uppercase hex digest is rejected
cases.note: Digests are compared as exact lowercase hex; no provider sends uppercase.

cases.name: header_equals: empty secret refuses a request without the header
cases.note: An empty secret would otherwise equal the empty value of an absent header.

cases.name: query_param: empty secret refuses a request without the parameter
hmac_sha256: empty secret refuses a body signed with an empty key
cases.note: An empty HMAC key is known to everyone, so anyone could sign.

cases.name: hmac_sha1: empty secret refuses a body signed with an empty key
none: empty secret still accepts
cases.note: The none scheme reads no secret.

cases.name: v2: slack documented example is valid at the signing time
cases.note: Secret, timestamp, body and signature are the worked example from Slack's request-verification guide.

cases.name: v2: timestamp exactly at the tolerance is accepted
v2: timestamp one second past the tolerance is refused
v2: timestamp too far in the future is refused
v2: timestamp exactly at the tolerance in the future is accepted
v2: missing timestamp header is refused
v2: non-numeric timestamp is refused
cases.note: Signed over the literal header, so only the timestamp check can refuse it.

cases.name: v2: negative timestamp is refused
v2: decimal timestamp is refused
v2: 20 digit timestamp is refused
cases.note: More than 19 characters is refused even when the digits are zeros followed by a fresh value.

cases.name: v2: timestamp beyond int64 is refused
v2: leading zeros within 19 digits are accepted
cases.note: Leading zeros are stripped before the range check: the value is 1531420618.

cases.name: v2: signature over the raw body alone is refused under the signed template
v2: uppercase hex digest is refused
v2: empty secret is refused
v2: signature under a different secret is refused
v2: signature with a different timestamp in the signed string is refused
v2: hmac_sha1 with a signed template and timestamp
v2: timestamp check applies to a raw body signature
v2: a stale timestamp is refused before the signature is compared
v2: form: JSON in the payload field becomes the document
v2: form: plus decodes to a space
v2: form: percent 20 decodes to a space
v2: form: lowercase hex escapes decode
v2: form: percent 2B decodes to a literal plus
v2: form: the first duplicate field wins
v2: form: invalid escape in the matching value yields an empty document and does not fall through
v2: form: invalid escape in another segment's name is skipped
v2: form: invalid escape in another segment's value is ignored
v2: form: truncated escape at the end is invalid
v2: form: semicolon is not a separator
v2: form: field name matches case sensitively
v2: form: field value with trailing semicolon is not JSON
v2: form: empty segments are skipped
v2: form: segment without equals sign has an empty value
v2: form: encoded field name matches
v2: form: payload that is a JSON scalar yields an empty document
v2: form: payload that is not JSON yields an empty document
v2: form: payload with trailing garbage yields an empty document
v2: form: JSON array payload is the document
cases.note: Numeric path segments index arrays; {body.type} on a list is empty.

cases.name: v2: form: JSON body wins over the form field
v2: form: empty JSON object is the document and the form is not tried
v2: form: no form field set leaves a form body without a document
v2: form: non-UTF-8 bytes are decoded byte-wise
cases.note: The value decodes to bytes that are not valid UTF-8, so it is not JSON.

cases.name: v2: handshake: url_verification echoes the challenge
v2: handshake: other event type is not a challenge
v2: handshake: comparison is case sensitive
v2: handshake: bad signature is not answered
v2: handshake: stale timestamp is not answered
v2: handshake: missing challenge answers with an empty string
v2: handshake: numeric challenge is stringified
v2: handshake: when and respond are templates; raw resolves to empty outside the signed template
v2: handshake: when mismatch on a template
v2: handshake: spec without a handshake never answers
v2: idempotency: first alternative wins
v2: idempotency: second alternative when the first is missing
v2: idempotency: second alternative when the first is an empty string
v2: idempotency: both empty
v2: idempotency: zero is a non-empty string
v2: idempotency: non scalar first alternative falls through
v2: idempotency: mixed namespaces
v2: idempotency: channel as the last alternative
v2: idempotency: alternatives are not trimmed
cases.note: A space before the alternative makes it an unknown name.

cases.name: v2: idempotency: pipe outside a placeholder is literal
v2: idempotency: raw placeholder resolves to empty
v2: idempotency: multiple placeholders each take alternatives
v2: idempotency: array index must be canonical
v2: idempotency: non canonical array index does not resolve
v2: slack event_callback keys on event_id
v2: slack block_actions form keys on trigger_id
v2: slack block_actions form with a tampered body is refused
v2: slack slash command has no document and an empty key
cases.note: Slash commands carry their fields in the form body itself, outside the payload field; the document stays empty.
